authority.write_scope: isolated RafGitTools branch and draft PR only

allowed_claim_scope: structural validation of the executor contract
forbidden_promotions: remote Mapa contract considered canonical before merge/readback

indices.route_stop_condition: Stop after structural executor tests and exact branch validation; do not widen to producer runtime in this work item.

uncertainties: whether every repository-local AGENTS adapter exposes the new governance/data/privacy/security questions
whether remote CI executes the new validator on the exact candidate head

evidence.evidence_scope: provider file/commit materialization only; tests not yet observed for this successor

governance.basis: Mapa owns federated authority while RafGitTools owns executor validation; merge/promotion remains separate.

data.basis: This work item contains contracts, paths and commit references; no private dataset payload is required.

privacy.basis: No raw private conversation, identity dataset or sensor payload is copied into the executor fixture.

security.basis: The validator controls fail-closed routing and must not allow hardcoded security/provenance success or high-risk rollback omission.

execution.gate: python3 -m unittest tests/test_agent_entry_kernel.py tests/test_federated_work_item.py -v && python3 scripts/check_agent_entry_kernel.py && python3 scripts/validate_federated_work_item.py examples/federated_work_item.fgap-fnext-20260819.json
execution.falsifier: Any missing Q01-Q12, missing governance/data/privacy/security dimension, invalid Mapa authority pointer, resolved-without-evidence state, or high-risk mutation without concrete rollback must fail non-zero.
execution.exit_criterion: All bounded tests pass on exact candidate bytes and the canonical validator reports PASS with claim_allowed=false.
execution.stop_condition: After executor validation and receipt emission, route remaining producer-specific changes to their local authority instead of expanding scope automatically.

delta_targets.Drive_reconstruction_target_or_TOKEN_VAZ: RAFAELIA — Implementação Latentes e Papers — Drive GitHub V1 append-only delta

f3.F_ok: Mapa contract/index and RafGitTools executor code are materialized on isolated branches.
f3.F_gap: Exact test execution, producer adapter reconciliation, remote CI and merge/readback remain open.
f3.F_next: Run the bounded validator suite, emit receipt, then patch producer AGENTS adapters only where the new entry questions are missing.
